words.reserved_for: the evidence tag on an empirical claim in a spec document (A3): asserted, load-bearing, and nobody has checked
words.form: (unverified) as a tag in a spec document; in this plugin's files, code formatting only

words.reserved_for: the lock label `status: processing`: a command holds the issue
the label `status: blocked`: the loop waits on the human
the review severity `blocking`: must fix before the CR moves
words.form: `blocking` in a severity marker or list, code formatting only

words.reserved_for: the authority tag `(assumed)` on an unconfirmed decision, and the first token of the evidence tag `(assumed-empirical: <risk>)` (A3)
the forge event type `labeled`, read by the gate-label audit (#144)
the QA suite-map row value `uncovered`: a scenario with no test
the amendment-line marker `unfolded`: an amendment not yet folded into the contract
